79359.subject: 🔷 The Daily: The CFTC sends its crypto rulemaking to the White House
79359.body:
Kevin O'Leary is buying crypto again, says major stock exchange adoption is the 'watershed moment' to watch | Bitcoin reclaims $80,000, Solana and Hyperliquid rally as crypto markets shrug off Clarity setback | Stablecoin payments firm dtcpay closes $25 million Series A with SBI Group investment | Ava Labs president says NYSE spent a year testing Avalanche technology for tokenization plans |

The Daily ( https://www.theblock.co/?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Written by James Hunt | Edited by Kyle Baird

Presented By:

( https://bron.org/?utm_source=TheBlock&utm_medium=Email&utm_campaign=DailyNewsletter&utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Happy Friday! Crypto markets are showing renewed appetite for upside despite hawkish central banks and the *Clarity Act* setback, with *Block Scholes' Andrew Melville* pointing to bullish options positioning and *Wincent's Paul Howard* seeing digital assets becoming less tied to macroeconomic data.

In today's newsletter, the *CFTC* files crypto asset rulemaking with the *White House* , *Kevin O'Leary* is buying crypto again, *Bitcoin* reclaims $80,000 as *Solana* and *Hyperliquid* rally, and more.

Meanwhile, *Grayscale's Zcash* ETF plans ( https://www.theblock.co/news/markets/2026-09-18-grayscales-zcash-etf-plans-3-for-1-split-233-million-inflow-surge-415520?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) a 3-for-1 split after a $233 million inflow surge.

*P.S.* Don't forget to check out The Funding , a biweekly rundown of crypto VC trends. It's a great read — and just like The Daily , it's free to subscribe ( https://www.theblock.co/newsletters?select=The%20Funding&utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) !

*THE BIG ONE*

*🏛️ CFTC files crypto asset rulemaking with White House, pressing ahead without Congress*

( https://www.theblock.co/news/regulation/2026-09-18-cftc-files-crypto-asset-rulemaking-with-white-house-pressing-ahead-without-congress-415510?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

The *CFTC* sent its crypto rulemaking to the *White House* for review, filing "Regulation Crypto Asset Transactions and Regulation Crypto Asset Markets" with the Office of Information and Regulatory Affairs.

* The agency declined to comment on details about the proposals, which now sit with OIRA, the body that reviews federal regulations before publication.
* The filing is the latest sign of federal agencies pressing ahead on their own after the *Clarity Act* failed its *Senate* procedural vote Tuesday.
* It caps a busy week for regulators, following the *SEC's* "innovation exemption" for tokenized stocks and the CFTC's own no-action stance for software developers.
* CFTC Chair *Michael Selig* had signaled the agency would use its existing authorities to build a crypto market-structure regime if Clarity stalled.
